title: body scan — the membrane is you
description: center on the human body. look from within and without. see your own journey on your skin and that of kin.

body_as_membrane.insight: the membrane model IS the body. skin is the device layer. the core is being born right now.

skin.description: what the world touches first. your boundary. the crust.
skin.shows: scars, sun, time, exposure — the record of everywhere you've been
skin.direction: faces outward — the world reads you here
skin.scan: what do you see on the surface? what has the world written on you?

fascia.description: connective tissue. how you hold yourself. tension patterns.
fascia.shows: posture, guarding, openness — the shape of how you meet the world
fascia.scan: where do you hold tension? where are you open? where are you guarded?

bones.description: the framework. what holds you up. what doesn't bend.
bones.shows: breaks healed, growth plates closed, the architecture of standing
bones.direction: holds — neither in nor out, just IS
bones.scan: what broke and healed stronger? what structure do you rely on?

blood.description: what flows. what carries. what feeds and cleans.
blood.shows: what you ate today, what you breathed, what stressed you, what nourished you
blood.direction: circulates — carries signal from core to skin and back
blood.scan: what is flowing through you right now? what are you carrying?

marrow.description: where new blood is born. the factory. the core that creates.
marrow.shows: what your body is making right now. new cells. new responses. adaptation.
marrow.direction: creates — everything radiates outward from here
marrow.scan: what is being born in you right now? what are you becoming?

from_within.perspective: you look out through your own eyes
from_within.sees: your hands, your skin, the world beyond your boundary
from_within.feeling: what does it feel like to be inside this body right now?

from_without.perspective: you look at yourself as others see you
from_without.sees: your posture, your expression, the marks of your journey
from_without.feeling: what would a stranger read on your surface?

gaze.mix: both perspectives blend. you are the observer AND the observed. the chipmunk inside you looks up at your own awareness. the squirrel outside you sees what the world sees.

kin.description: kin are the bodies whose membranes overlap with yours

types.blood_kin: shared marrow — same factory, similar patterns, inherited structure
types.chosen_kin: shared fascia — you hold the world the same way, tension in the same places
types.proximity_kin: shared skin — same weather, same neighborhood, same exposure
types.journey_kin: shared blood — carrying the same things right now, flowing in the same direction
types.signal_kin: shared bones — same breaks healed, same structure relied upon

kin.overlap: where your membrane touches another's, the boundary becomes a braid. their journey shows on your skin. your journey shows on theirs.
kin.scan: who do you see when you look at your own surface? whose marks are also yours?

step_1.name: surface
step_1.instruction: look at your hands. what do you see?

step_2.name: tension
step_2.instruction: where are you holding? shoulders? jaw? belly?

step_3.name: structure
step_3.instruction: what holds you up right now? what framework are you standing on?

step_4.name: flow
step_4.instruction: what is moving through you? breath? thought? anxiety? calm?

step_5.name: core
step_5.instruction: what is being born in you right now? what are you becoming?

step_6.name: kin
step_6.instruction: whose journey do you see on your skin alongside your own?
